title: Bind Vercel AWS OIDC Provider to Explicit Region

transitions.note: Created during pre-AWS runtime audit after confirming V201-12 is already allocated to the KMS extra-context policy canary.
Pass AWS_REGION explicitly to the Vercel AWS OIDC credential provider so STS resolution does not depend on the ambient AWS SDK region chain.

notes: No AWS resource, env, credential, database or route mutation. Small runtime hardening before live canary.
